description: BDSM consent frameworks adapted for Antahpura. SSC, RACK, PRICK, and SSICK provide the ethical foundation for every scene and dynamic interaction.

design_principles.principle_1: Consent is the foundation. No scene, punishment, task, or reward occurs without informed consent.
design_principles.principle_2: Consent is ongoing, not a one-time event.
design_principles.principle_3: Consent can be revoked at any time by any party.
design_principles.principle_4: Consent frameworks provide language for risk negotiation.
design_principles.principle_5: Different characters may prefer different frameworks; the dynamic uses the strictest applicable.

SSC.name: Safe, Sane, Consensual
SSC.description: The original BDSM risk management framework. Emphasizes safety, rationality, and consent.

core_principals.safe: Activities should minimize risk of physical and emotional harm.
core_principals.sane: Participants should be of sound mind and capable of making informed decisions.
core_principals.consensual: All parties must give informed, ongoing consent.

antahpura_adaptation.safe: Kala mastery and institutional protocols reduce risk
antahpura_adaptation.consensual: Traffic light system provides ongoing consent

RACK.name: Risk-Aware Consensual Kink
RACK.description: Evolved from SSC to acknowledge that all intimacy has risk. Emphasizes informed risk acceptance.

core_principals.risk_aware: Participants acknowledge and accept the risks involved.
core_principals.kink: Activities are done with full awareness of potential consequences.

antahpura_adaptation.risk_aware: Kala mastery prepares for risk; consent records document acceptance
antahpura_adaptation.consensual: Traffic light system provides ongoing consent
antahpura_adaptation.kink: All Antahpura scenes are RACK-compliant by default

PRICK.name: Personal Responsibility, Informed Consensual Kink
PRICK.description: Emphasizes personal responsibility and informed choice.

core_principals.personal_responsibility: Each participant takes responsibility for their own experience.
core_principals.informed: Participants are fully informed about risks and activities.

antahpura_adaptation.personal_responsibility: Characters are responsible for their own state and recovery
antahpura_adaptation.informed: Kala and kama lifecycle progression informs readiness
antahpura_adaptation.consensual: Traffic light system provides ongoing consent
antahpura_adaptation.kink: PRICK is the recommended framework for advanced Antahpura characters

SSICK.name: Safe, Sane, Informed, Consensual Kink
SSICK.description: A synthesis of SSC and RACK, adding explicit emphasis on information.

antahpura_adaptation.note: SSICK is the recommended framework for Antahpura, combining SSC's accessibility with RACK's realism and PRICK's accountability.

framework_selection_matrix.description: Which framework is appropriate for which character and context.

steps.name: Before Care Check-In
steps.content: Discuss hard limits, soft limits, and aftercare needs while sober and calm.

steps.name: Framework Agreement
steps.content: Agree on which consent framework (SSC/RACK/PRICK/SSICK) governs this scene.

steps.name: Traffic Light Setup
steps.content: Confirm traffic light signals (green/yellow/red) and non-verbal alternatives.

steps.name: Scene Parameters
steps.content: Define what is on the table, what is off, and what is negotiable.

steps.name: Aftercare Plan
steps.content: Define aftercare needs for both parties.

steps.name: Documentation
steps.content: Record the negotiation in a shared note or contract.
